RealtimeBoard combines all these pieces in one place to let your team or whole organization collaborate beyond formats, tools, locations and timezones. Now we have every Upworker able to use RealtimeBoard. Shipra Kayan, Director, Product Design Research, Upwork RealtimeBoard is the #1 online whiteboard trusted by over 1.5 million users from global companies big and small. It can be a focal point for your offline meetings, or an endless workspace for distributed collaboration. RealtimeBoard is your company-wide normalization layer for notes, media, data and other inputs — all from different sources and in different formats. RealtimeBoard follows the natural workflow of your team, big or small... As a team, you have your favourite apps and tools. As a company, you work with trusted vendors and reliable products. Our goal is to support your existing workflow. Our deep integrations with cloud storage services, G-suite, product development and graphic design tools are created to simplify and accelerate your collaboration.
